summary_1line: Garuda attacks the gods to seize the guarded Soma, scattering and wounding them with the storm of his wings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda darkens the sky as the hurricane from his vast wings raises choking dust that blinds the assembled gods guarding the Soma.
The colossal Garuda claws and tears through the ranks of the gods while Indra and the celestials hurl maces, discs, and arrows upward at him.
After Vayu blows away the dust, the blazing bird-king hovers in the sky roaring like a doomsday cloud while the gods gather below with weapons raised.
